subject: "Disconnected from server" error on blank grey page when deploying shinyApp on shinyapps.io.  Works fine locally.

messages.author: d20f7f56e37159c1
messages.subject: "Disconnected from server" error on blank grey page when deploying shinyApp on shinyapps.io.  Works fine locally.
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am able to have my Shiny app work locally, but it gives me the error: "Disconnected from server" on a blank, grey page when I deploy it to shinyapps.io to share.  Here is my code:

library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)


ui <- fluidPage(plotOutput("plot1"))

server <- function(input, output) {
  MY_DATA <- read.csv("/Users/'myusername'/Desktop/APPTRY/MY_DATA.csv")
    output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
      plot(MY_DATA$Charge, MY_DATA$X..of.Claims)
    })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

My app.R file is also saved in the path that I cite within the read.csv command.

Any help would be appreciated!!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: "Disconnected from server" error on blank grey page when deploying shinyApp on shinyapps.io.  Works fine locally.
parts:
Here is the section of the documentation on debugging your application.
You are trying to read a file with an absolute path, you need to switch to a relative path.
